desc.en: Farm in Ayamonte, province of Huelva. Farm with a 2.3ha plot, with 3 buildings. First building recently renovated, with PVC windows, 2 fireplaces and dressing room. It is distributed in a living room, open-plan kitchen, 3 bedrooms and a bathroom. The second building is a typical 2-story country house with high ceilings with wooden beams. It is distributed on the ground floor: entrance hall, kitchen, 2 dining rooms, a living room with fireplace and a complete bathroom. On the second floor there are 2 living rooms, one of them with a fireplace, 5 bedrooms and a bathroom. From the second floor there is access to the roof terrace which occupies the same area as the house. The third building is not yet finished, but it would be a guest house. The exterior of the house is equipped with a swimming pool, barbecue area, garden and chicken coop. As for basic supplies, the water comes from 1 artesian well, extracted by an electric pump, and the electricity connected to the city supply, with the Endesa company. The farm has very good access from the A49 highway and is located just 2km from Ayamonte. Request more information now, don't miss this opportunity.
